title: Hello World!
excerpt: A brief introduction to who I am, my interests, and my skills.
alt: Animated gif of medium-brown skinned hand emoji waving
content:
Hi! I'm Abhilasha! I'm a software developer currently studying for a Masters in Computer Engineering at UCF. In 2024, I graduated from NYU with a Bachelor's in Computer Science and Mathematics. I'm a programmer, math nerd, animal lover, digital artist, amateur cook, aspiring web dev, and tabletop role playing game afficionado.

I created this website to showcase my interests and projects, ranging from art to computing to anything else that I may be interested in at the moment. It will contain various web apps and documentation about projects I've worked on. As of now the site in is a very preliminary state, but it will be updated with more content soon. Check back later to see what I've added!
